<!--
  catalog — an enumerated reference list of a named, governed set (the roles that exist,
  the notification events that exist, the statuses that exist).
  Lives at: `<domain>/catalogs/<kebab-name>.md` — pick the sub-wiki by what the catalog's members ARE, which is
    the same thing as what it must cite: an industry-governed set that cites nothing of ours is `domain/` (MCC codes,
    ISO countries); a set of our own coded values, including the entitlement tiers and what each gates, is `product/` — and
    that tiers catalog is the one home for what each tier gates, which a gtm `pricing-model` links rather
    than restating as commercial packaging;
    a design token group, or the icon set the `design-system` page names in `icon-catalog:`, is `design/`. A catalog lives at the shallowest sub-wiki whose layer covers every reference
    it needs to make.
  Authorship: curated. SLO: 365d — a roster that rots faster sets its own `freshness:` on the page.
  Distinct from: `data-model-entity` (one named thing with a data-model table), `concept` (a mental
    model, not a membership list), and a single entity's inline `## Enumerations` (owned and
    co-located, not cross-page).
  Discipline: use a catalog when multiple unrelated pages resolve a coded value against ONE
    authoritative list — deleting it would strand them. In `product/`, a catalog's entries are not
    features (the product README's feature boundary).
  Required: `## Entries` — the section this type exists for; `None.` is not an answer there.
  Disposition: keep every header; "None." when empty.
  Substitute: {{TITLE}} {{DATE}} {{OWNER}} {{CONFIDENCE}}.
-->
